Senior Backend Engineer

Remote (EU timezones)

About the role
You will own our scheduling and billing services end to end, working with product and the data team. You will mentor two junior engineers and set technical direction for the billing domain.

Requirements
- 5+ years building production backend services, at least 3 with Node.js or Go
- Deep PostgreSQL experience: query tuning, migrations, transactional correctness
- Experience designing and evolving REST or gRPC APIs consumed by other teams
- You have mentored engineers and enjoy it
- Comfortable being on call for services you own

Nice to have
- Exposure to Kubernetes and Terraform
- Logistics or supply chain background
- Experience with event streaming (Kafka, NATS)

Benefits
Competitive salary and equity. 30 days holiday. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Software Engineer

We are looking for a talented engineer to join our growing team. Apply now!

Data Engineer

Requirements
- 3+ years with Python and dbt
- Strong SQL and dimensional modelling
- Experience owning production data pipelines

Nice to have
- Airflow or Dagster

- Kubernetes in production, not just in tutorials

Preferred
